ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity white surface area versus 30% low-intensity black peripheral border and localized mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central region bisected by a dark vertical median notch projection. The right lobe is predominantly high-intensity with a single thin, dark curvilinear mark in the lower-outer quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge. A distinct irregular protrusion is visible at the apex of the left lobe lobe, while the right lobe apex exhibits a smoother, more tapered terminal curve.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge contour transitioning to sharp convex curvatures at the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single distinct dark linear disruption oriented vertically on the lower-right lobe; jagged, non-uniform pixel transitions on the inner-left lobe border suggesting rake marks or historic scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable accumulation of dark organic material (macroalgae) attached to the superior-distal tip of the left lobe. Irregular, jagged loss of pigmentation on the interior trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent dark vertical 'pillar' of pigmentation extending from the median notch into the center of the ventral white field.
